item: Row 302: the export summary reads the drive's manifests with the hardened reader
summary: oo-folder-backup.json and volumes.json in the export destination were read with a plain read_text: a named pipe blocked the summary, a link to /dev/zero read without end, deep nesting raised. Both now go through R780's read_manifest_json (no link followed, no blocking, bounded size and nesting); a manifest of another shape counts nothing instead of crashing the summary; an unreadable folder manifest is logged by fixed words.
